items.quote: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
items.claim: Moses reports to God that when he comes to the children of Israel and tells them God sent him, they will ask what God's name is

items.quote: and they shall say to me, What is his name?
items.claim: The children of Israel will ask Moses for God's name

items.quote: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM
items.claim: God reveals to Moses that his name is "I AM THAT I AM"

items.quote: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
items.claim: God instructs Moses to tell the children of Israel that "I AM" sent him
